prs.title: AUTOPILOT v4.1: canonical scheduler state and CAS control plane
prs.head: autopilot/v4-control-plane
prs.purpose_hint: Introduces the machine-readable scheduler state used by the five V4 automations. `state.json` is authoritative current state; issue comments become audit-only. Updates use GitHub Contents blob-SHA compare-and-swap to prevent stale overwrites. Adds explicit blocker classes, Cursor-unavailable-until-2026-09-18 execution constraint, public-GitHub-Actions-first reusable execution, and provider outcome handling where account-specific AI capability restriction is account health rather than a system/product blocker. No product/runtime/provider secrets are included.
